item.text: {"counterevidence":["The capacity snapshot is stale: its source was posted 34.11 hours before the decision time, beyond the 30-hour freshness threshold.","The conditional shortfalls assume the August 30 scheduled quantities remain unchanged; future nominations and rerouting are not observed.","Several current restrictions and capacity changes may reflect scheduling evolution, netting, confirmation, or operating conditions rather than measured physical flow.","Lower 48 working gas was 5.5% above its five-year average, which is a looser national storage backdrop than a deficit.","No regional basis price, production, measured-flow, or rerouting observation is available to confirm a local price or physical-balance outcome."],"facts":[{"claim":"The system-level signal is reduced transport availability at selected TGP segments, not a demonstrated loss of U.S. gas supply or end-user demand. The most direct potential channel is regional basis and transport congestion; no point-in-time regional supply, demand, measured-flow, or rerouting denominator is available to size a national balance effect.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"]},{"claim":"Storage context is above recent norms: Lower 48 working gas was 3,184 Bcf, 5.5% above the five-year average, while East storage was 727 Bcf, 5.1% above average. South Central was 1,061 Bcf, 3.0% above average, after a 19 Bcf weekly withdrawal. These are regime context, not effects of a TGP event.","evidence_ids":["eia_wngsr:1788115874039669000:c7dd258cb0915a825acbed60129cdeb5e37aaf8e0ebe0021c97414369d461469"]},{"claim":"The authoritative change ledger shows a forecast operating-capacity cut of 645,000 Dth/day (41.6%) at Station 534 South of Pool, segment 530 BH, from 1.55 million to 905,000 Dth/day for revised forecast periods spanning September 7 to October 11. This is a report revision, not proof of a physical-flow change.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"The ledger also shows forecast capacity relief at Station 245, segment 245 FH: operating capacity was raised 290,000 Dth/day (42.6%), from 680,000 to 970,000 Dth/day for September 21–27. This offsets neither other segments nor establishes a system-wide net change.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932512717694000:4e5308a6b60198988cebfe87c90c7936ec29248dea254a2e2949d8b71262ebc6","km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063"]},{"claim":"An emergent repair notice identified Station 563 Unit 1A near Centerville, Tennessee, with an estimated additional impact of up to 315,000 Dth/day through Station 860 North, segment 860 BH. The notice said certain nomination increases were at risk, while previously scheduled volumes would not be curtailed; subsequent capacity confirmation is still needed.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_critical:1788110122419257000:5c924dc6c23dab467c649f8808dc8af00af0e929cc7dc5c389521b9eec637518","km_tgp_notice_detail:1788110156344773000:f6e560a11a28f7db622d566fd415c012ffc4e7a8baa3d17f365651da6e2b059d"]},{"claim":"The August 30 operating-capacity snapshot is stale. Its reported available capacity is transportation headroom, not measured physical flow; it also contains one reconciliation mismatch and operator caveats permitting differences between scheduled, operating, and available capacity.","evidence_ids":["km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"]}],"glossary":[{"definition":"The price difference between gas at a regional location and a benchmark such as Henry Hub.","term":"basis"},{"definition":"A projected gap between a captured scheduled quantity and forecast operating capacity, assuming that schedule does not change. It is not measured flow or a confirmed curtailment.","term":"conditional scheduled shortfall"},{"definition":"A standard unit of natural-gas energy; Dth/day means dekatherms per day.","term":"Dth/day"},{"definition":"Capacity available to transport additional gas after operating constraints and scheduling considerations; it is not physical flow.","term":"operationally available capacity"}],"headline":"TGP transport constraints merit regional-basis monitoring, but stale capacity data and absent regional price/flow evidence limit confidence.","missing_data":["A current capacity snapshot; the available source is 34.11 hours old and exceeds the 30-hour freshness threshold.","Regional TGP basis prices and an exact TGP leg-to-contract mapping.","Point-in-time regional supply, demand, measured-flow, and rerouting data needed to express capacity changes as a share of the affected balance.","Updated nominations and operating-capacity confirmation for the Station 563 emergent repair and the current restriction notices.","Detail text for notices 403833 and 403852."],"overall_confidence":"low","plain_english_summary":"TGP has several planned and near-term transport constraints, with the largest calculated conditional shortfall of 668,684 Dth/day at Station 860 in Z1 for September 14–20 if the August 30 schedule holds. Storage is above five-year norms nationally and in the East, which provides broad market context but does not explain or offset any individual TGP constraint. The relevant channel is regional transport and basis, not a demonstrated Henry Hub or national supply/demand effect. Confidence is low because the capacity snapshot is stale and regional prices, flows, rerouting, and the affected-balance denominator are unavailable.","watch_items":[{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["A current operating-capacity and nomination snapshot for the same direction and gas day.","Evidence of whether nominations were reduced or rerouted during September 14–20.","Regional basis observations tied to the affected TGP path."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["Forecast operating capacity is revised above the captured 1,393,684 Dth/day schedule.","Nominations decline or are rerouted so the calculated gap disappears.","Updated operational data show the outage does not constrain the aligned direction."],"market_channel":"regional-basis and transport","research_status":"research_scenario","scenario":"For September 14–20, Station 860 (segment 548 BH, Z1) has forecast operating capacity of 725,000 Dth/day against a captured August 30 schedule of 1,393,684 Dth/day, producing a conditional 668,684 Dth/day shortfall if that schedule holds. Any basis response is conditional rather than established.","title":"Station 860 Z1 transport-fit scenario"},{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["A current same-cycle capacity and nomination observation at Station 313.","Confirmation of the September 7–13 forecast operating capacity.","Regional basis and rerouting observations for the affected path."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["Forecast capacity is restored above the captured 707,875 Dth/day schedule.","Future nominations are reduced or rerouted, eliminating the calculated gap.","The aligned direction or station match is superseded by updated operator information."],"market_channel":"regional-basis and transport","research_status":"research_scenario","scenario":"For September 7–13, Station 313 Discharge (segment 399 FH, Z4) has forecast operating capacity of 220,000 Dth/day versus a captured 707,875 Dth/day schedule, a conditional 487,875 Dth/day shortfall if the schedule is unchanged. This is a transport-fit scenario, not a price forecast.","title":"Station 313 Z4 transport-fit scenario"},{"confidence":"low","confirmation_needed":["Updated operator notice or capacity evidence quantifying the Station 563 repair effect.","Current nominations and restrictions through Station 860 North.","Evidence that affected nomination increases were actually curtailed rather than accommodated or rerouted."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_critical:1788110122419257000:5c924dc6c23dab467c649f8808dc8af00af0e929cc7dc5c389521b9eec637518","km_tgp_notice_detail:1788110156344773000:f6e560a11a28f7db622d566fd415c012ffc4e7a8baa3d17f365651da6e2b059d"],"invalidation":["The operator resolves the repair or withdraws the restriction.","Updated information shows no additional operating-capacity reduction or nomination impact.","Nominations are accommodated without restriction or rerouted."],"market_channel":"transport","research_status":"monitor","scenario":"The Station 563 Unit 1A emergent repair could constrain additional nominations through Station 860 North by up to 315,000 Dth/day, but the notice did not establish an operating-capacity reduction or curtail existing scheduled volumes.","title":"Station 563 emergent-repair monitoring"}],"why_it_matters":"Transport constraints can matter most through localized deliverability and regional basis when scheduled demand for a path exceeds forecast operating capacity. Here, the largest scenarios are conditional, capacity observations are stale, and there is no regional price or physical-flow evidence to establish a realized market impact. Henry Hub physical spot was $2.70/MMBtu for the August 25 observation, but it is national benchmark context—not evidence of a TGP regional-basis effect.
